lines.say: lab-made amylin, a hormone it releases with insulin; blunts glucagon's rise after meals
food intake falls as fullness rises
after-meal sugar falls; HbA1c about 0.3 points lower than placebo, with insulin
0.8 to 1.6 kg lost versus small gains on placebo (not approved for weight loss)
glucose checked often around meals and at bedtime, especially when starting
boxed warning: severe lows with insulin, more in type 1, usually within 3 hours of a shot
nausea in 48% versus 17% on placebo in type 1 diabetes, mostly early on
headache in 13% versus 7% on placebo in type 2 diabetes

ask: How should my insulin plan change to lower the risk of severe lows?
